svg.title: A trie built from car cart cat dog by spell, then a word checked and a prefix completed
svg.text: a node, numbered in the order made

g.title: Adding "car": the root has no child for c, so node 1 is made.
Adding "car": the root has no child for a, so node 2 is made.
Adding "car": the root has no child for r, so node 3 is made; "car" ends here, so node 3 is marked as a word.
Adding "cart": "car" is there already (nodes 1, 2, 3); node 4 is made, and node 4 is marked as a word.
Adding "cat": "ca" is there already (nodes 1, 2); node 5 is made, and node 5 is marked as a word.
Adding "dog": nothing is shared; nodes 6, 7, 8 are made, and node 8 is marked as a word.
Checking the text "cab": c and a lead to node 2, which has no child for b: "cab" is no word, and spell prints it.
-p ca: the walk down the prefix ends at node 2. Every word that starts with "ca" is below it, and nothing else is.
Below node 2, children are taken from a to z: node 3 is "car", a word, printed in its turn.
Below node 2, children are taken from a to z: node 4 is "cart", a word, printed in its turn.
Below node 2, children are taken from a to z: node 5 is "cat", a word, printed in its turn.
